definition_zh: 大部分；大量；体积；散装的
definition_en: the main or largest part of something
scene: 仓库的门一开，里面全是麻袋。The bulk of the grain is stored here.
sceneCN: 这里 bulk 是「大部分」（第 1 个义项：整体中占多数的部分）；句意是大部分粮食都存在这里。

senses.title: The largest part
senses.definition: the main or largest part of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物中占主要或最大的部分
senses.example: The bulk of the grain is stored here.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分粮食都存在这里。
senses.why: A heap seen as a whole is mostly its mass.
senses.whyCN: 把一堆东西看作整体，其中最多的就是它的主体。

senses.title: Great size or volume
senses.definition: the large size or mass of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物庞大的体积或分量
senses.example: The bulk of the ship filled the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 那艘船庞大的船身占满了港口。
senses.why: The physical sense of a heap came before the idea of a share.
senses.whyCN: 「堆」这个具体形象早于「份额」这一抽象概念。

senses.title: Sold in large amounts
senses.definition: sold loose or in large amounts, without packing
senses.definitionCN: 散装或大批出售，没有小包装
senses.example: Rice is cheaper when bought in bulk.
senses.exampleCN: 大米大批购买时更便宜。
senses.why: Goods sold by the heap rather than the packet took the word.
senses.whyCN: 按堆而不是按包出售的货物，用了这个词。

intro.en: Bulk first meant the cargo in a ship's hold, then any great mass.
intro.cn: bulk 最初指船舱里的货物，后指任何庞大的堆积。

items.en: bulke named the cargo piled in a ship.
items.cn: bulke 指堆在船里的货物。

items.en: bulk widened to any large mass or body.
items.cn: bulk 扩展到任何大的形体或堆积。

items.en: The bulk of meant the greater part.
items.cn: the bulk of 指「大部分」。

items.en: Trade in bulk named goods sold loose.
items.cn: trade in bulk 指散装货物交易。

items.en: bulk covers the main part, great size and loose goods.
items.cn: 如今 bulk 涵盖主要部分、庞大体量与散装货物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bul- opening; the near-meaning group gives amount and size words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bul- 开头；近义组是数量与体积类的词。

entries.definition: the glass part of a lamp
a large heavy ship or person
more than half of a group
a large amount without a clear shape
the amount of space something fills

normalIntro.en: Bulk is a heap big enough to be most of the pile.
normalIntro.cn: bulk 就是大到占去整堆大部分的那一垛。

normal.en: The bulk of the cost is the roof.
normal.cn: 费用的大部分在屋顶上。

normal.en: You buy rice in bulk to save money.
A bulk carrier ships loose goods.
Bulk buying lowers the unit price.

abstract.en: See sacks stacked to the ceiling.
abstract.cn: 想象麻袋一直堆到屋顶。

abstract.en: See a hull filling the whole dock.
abstract.cn: 想象船身占满整个船坞。

abstract.en: See grain poured loose into a bin.
abstract.cn: 想象粮食散着倒进仓里。

examples.en: The bulk of the grain is stored here.
examples.cn: 大部分粮食都存在这里。

examples.en: The bulk of the ship filled the harbour.
examples.cn: 那艘船庞大的船身占满了港口。

examples.en: Rice is cheaper when bought in bulk.
examples.cn: 大米大批购买时更便宜。

dict_mnemonic.text: bulk 与 bull 只差一个字母，公牛站在那儿，占的分量就是一大块。

root: bulk 中古英语作 bulke，本指船舱里成堆的货物；十六世纪起指庞大体量，十七世纪有了「大部分」的说法，十九世纪起用于「散装、大批」的商业语境。

sensesIntro.en: The biggest share, the size of a heap, and goods sold loose.
sensesIntro.cn: 最大的份额、一堆东西的体积、以及散着卖的货物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sacks piled high in a warehouse.
core.cn: 核心意象：仓库里堆得高高的麻袋。

intro.en: Bulk takes -y and -iness to describe heavy size.
intro.cn: bulk 加 -y 与 -iness 可描述笨重的体积。

latinIntro.en: The base is Middle English; the Latin items below are related only in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自中古英语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。
